ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level contrast; approximately 80% high-intensity white/light-gray pixels to 20% low-intensity black pixels localized primarily at the margins.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular trailing edge; left lobe shows high-frequency micro-serrations; right lobe features a prominent, deep rectangular excision (notch) midway along the trailing boundary.

localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several parallel, dark-pixel linear markings (rake marks) visible on the lower right lobe near the water line, oriented diagonally relative to the leading edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent physical trauma in the form of a missing rectangular segment on the inner trailing edge of the right lobe; cluster of live calcified barnacles attached to the extreme distal tip of the left lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Localized bio-fouling clusters present on both extreme lateral tips, creating high-relief, irregular silhouettes against the background.
